name: schedule-picker
purpose: Choose when something happens in one form control: start and end (DateTime Pickers, or Date Pickers for all-day), an all-day checkbox, an optional timezone select, and an optional embedded Recurrence Picker. The value is a ScheduleValue (instants with a timezone, or dates) and the form value is iCalendar text (DTSTART, DTEND, RRULE, EXDATE).
whenToUse: Event, meeting, booking, or maintenance-window editors.
Anything with a start, an end, and optionally a repetition, where timezones matter.
whenNotToUse: A single moment: use DateTime Picker.
A range of dates without times: Date Range Picker is lighter.
A duration without a start: use Duration Picker.
responsive: Start and end sit side by side when there is room (auto-fit grid, 14rem minimum) and stack below; reflows at 320 px without horizontal scrolling. The embedded Recurrence Picker wraps its rows.
rtl: All parts follow the direction option; the inner pickers mirror their segments and popups.
theme: Uses the inner pickers' styles plus the shared control surface for the timezone select; the recurrence section is separated by a border. Import the Date Input, Calendar, Date Picker, DateTime Picker, and (with recurrence) Recurrence Picker styles as well.
timezone: Timed values are Instants read and entered in `value.timeZone` (or the select, or the timezone option; UTC by default, section 8.1) with the DST policy (section 8.5). Changing the timezone keeps the wall-clock times and recomputes the instants. All-day values are PlainDate with an inclusive last day; the iCalendar DTEND of all-day values is exclusive (the next day), as RFC 5545 requires.
security: Text via textContent; timezone names from Intl. The form value is produced by the component, never parsed as HTML.
dataHandling: No persistence or network access. One hidden input carries the iCalendar text when `name` is set; inner pickers are not registered with Form and their radios are not submitted.

budgets.budget: < 30 ms per instance in headless Chromium (e2e performance test)

performance.testedScale: One schedule per instance (four inner pickers and an optional Recurrence Picker).

limitations: One timezone for start and end.
The end follows the start with the previous duration; there is no separate duration field.
All-day schedules have no times; switching back to timed restores the previous start time (09:00 by default) and duration.
parseSchedule accepts TZID, UTC (Z), and VALUE=DATE forms only.
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
unsupported: Multiple date ranges in one value.
antiPatterns: Storing only the instants and dropping timeZone: the recurrence expands in the wall clock of that zone.
Treating the all-day end as exclusive in application code: ScheduleValue.end is the last day.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/schedule-picker: AuiSchedulePicker directive ([auiSchedulePicker]) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/schedule-picker: AuiSchedulePicker component; controlled (value/defaultValue + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
